name: kf_slus_main_exec_loop
summary: Resident PS1 overlay loader loop: configures 2MB RAM via SetMem(2), resets ISO9660 FS, loads OPEN.EXE/GAME.EXE/END.EXE into EXEC header 0x80010274 by selector DAT_800102f0, clears s_addr/s_size, enters critical section, executes child overlay, and repeats.

name: kf_slus_crt0_start
summary: SN Systems CRT0 entry (__SN_ENTRY_POINT): zeroes resident .bss 0x80010270..0x800102b4, saves BIOS return address into DAT_80010270, initializes main heap at 0x800102b8 (size 0x1e7d4c), and invokes resident main loader loop.

name: kf_slus_enter_critical_section
summary: PS1 BIOS EnterCriticalSection syscall wrapper (a0=1, syscall 0) disabling interrupts before handing control to loaded child executable via Exec().

name: kf_slus_bios_96_remove
summary: PS1 BIOS A0h:72h _96_remove stub tearing down the resident CD-ROM ISO9660 filesystem handler before cleanly re-initializing CD reading or executing an overlay.
